## Review Pulse – 4 Draft & validate
Claude writes **only** the prose (theme notes, observation, 3 actions) and **picks** quotes. Code inserts every number from the stats and every quote character-for-character, then validates: ≤250 words, exact quotes, numbers only from stats, 3 ratio metrics, ≤6 explainer bullets, ≥2 official links, Last checked.

Fails once → redraft with the exact failures. Fails twice → status `draft_failed` (nothing goes out).

Official pages are re-checked for the key facts the explainer relies on (`sources` tab).
